purpose: Provenance-preserving Karl_K / strmrdr observations from the existing #64 PriceScope archive, for downstream falsification of frozen Sparkles geometry/optical/perceptual methods. No new human or AI labels.

interpretation_contract.catalog_wording_is_not_verbatim: Every v1 source_wording field is the existing #64 catalog paraphrase unless wording_fidelity explicitly changes in a later revision.
interpretation_contract.grey_is_not_leakage: Do not normalize grey to leakage without an explicit source statement.
interpretation_contract.holdout_rule: A held_out_candidate may be called independent validation for a new method only if its observation was not used to design, tune, threshold, or select that method. Prior legacy-descriptor exposure is recorded separately.
interpretation_contract.mapping_rule: pending_geometry records must not acquire semantic facet IDs until #72 geometry is validated; original source wording/locality is immutable provenance.
